summary.what_it_does: The page is the opening of a USENIX ;login: article on the systems engineering side of Google's Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization. It explains that SRE draws on two main disciplines, Software Engineering and Systems Engineering. It describes Software Engineer and Systems Engineer as the two poles of an SRE skills continuum, with considerable overlap and fluid knowledge exchange between them. The visible text is only the introduction; the full article body is not included in the page text.
notable: Describes Google's SRE split into Software Engineering and Systems Engineering roles
Published in USENIX ;login: magazine, SYSADMIN section, June 2015 issue
Frames SWE and SE as poles of a skills continuum rather than fixed silos
caveats: Page text shows only the introduction; the rest of the article is not visible
